pricingMethodology.primary: Value-based pricing — price is set based on client value delivered, not cost-plus
pricingMethodology.secondary: Market reference — understand competitor pricing to ensure TCD's premium is justified but not excessive
pricingMethodology.costFloor: All quotes must achieve minimum 28% GM — below this the project does not cover operating overhead contribution
pricingMethodology.valueJustification: 6-year warranty, professional installation, project management, Australian-owned — these justify 20–40% premium over grey import alternatives

serviceMarkup.installation: 60–120% on labour cost — high-value service, client rarely negotiates this
serviceMarkup.floorplanCAD: Pure margin service — minimal direct cost

discountingPolicy.discountApproval: Above 5%: Project Manager approval. Above 10%: CEO approval.
discountingPolicy.conditionedDiscount: Any discount must be conditional: 'If we confirm the order this week, I can get approval for that reduction'
neverDiscount: Installation and delivery charges — this is a cost-based service
On the first quote — never discount before client has pushed back
Without understanding the real objection — price objection often masks a trust or value gap

priceEscalation.clientCommunication: Always notify client proactively if a quote is about to expire due to external pricing pressure — this is a genuine urgency signal

taxPositioning.GST: All quotes must state 'All prices exclusive of GST. GST will be applied to final invoice.'
taxPositioning.instantAssetWriteOff: Commercial furniture qualifies as a depreciable business asset. Clients purchasing before June 30 may access EOFY depreciation benefits. Always mention this March–June. Not licensed tax advice.
taxPositioning.inputTaxCredit: GST-registered client can claim the GST input tax credit on their BAS — reducing their effective cost by 9.09%
